key_terms.تَوْبَةٌ: Repentance; returning to Allah after sin

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith define repentance in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that sincere remorse over a sin is itself a core element of tawbah (repentance). It highlights the inward moral state of the believer and shows that true repentance begins with heartfelt regret before Allah.
